description: This file provides API functions for interacting with Thread network data, including fetching status, scan results, configuration, joining networks, and topology. It also contains mock data for development environment.

methods.name: getThreadStatus
methods.description: Fetches the current Thread network status, returns mock data in development.

methods.name: scanThreadNetworks
methods.description: Scans for available Thread networks, returns mock data in development.

methods.name: getThreadConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the current Thread network configuration, returns mock data in development.

methods.name: updateThreadConfiguration
methods.description: Updates the Thread network configuration via POST request or returns mock data in development.

methods.name: joinThreadNetwork
methods.description: Requests to join a Thread network, returns mock success in development.

methods.name: getThreadCommissioner
methods.description: Fetches Thread commissioner data, returns mock data in development.

methods.name: updateThreadCommissioner
methods.description: Updates Thread commissioner data, modifies mock data in development.

methods.name: getThreadTopology
methods.description: Retrieves Thread network topology data, returns mock data in development.
